companies.name: TigerByte Cyber
companies.solution: TigerByte Cyber has secured over $7 million in contracts with US government agencies, including the US Space Force, the US Navy, and DARPA.
companies.problem: Addressing cybersecurity needs for critical government agencies.
companies.korea_point: Its government contracts may indicate potential interest in expanding to other regions, including Korea.

companies.name: MIND
companies.solution: MIND is securing $72 million in funding to accelerate platform development and expand its presence in key enterprise markets using AI-powered data loss prevention (DLP) technology.
companies.problem: Protecting sensitive data from leaks in enterprise environments.
companies.korea_point: With significant funding, MIND may look to expand into the Korean market, which is increasingly focused on AI-driven security solutions.

companies.name: Vectra AI
companies.solution: Vectra AI launched Ascent, a program aimed at addressing the new era of AI-driven attacks by expanding its partner strategy and enhancing AI expertise and security outcomes.
companies.problem: Mitigating the growing threat of AI-driven cyberattacks in complex security environments.
companies.korea_point: As AI-driven threats grow, Vectra AI's expansion could be relevant to Korea's increasing focus on AI security.
